title: jobd: a self-hostable, GPU-aware job broker with native agent (MCP) integration
description: A self-hostable, GPU-aware job broker for personal and lab-scale compute. jobd queues long-running batch work across heterogeneous machines, matching jobs to workers by capability tags (CUDA, VRAM capacity, installed tooling), and exposes the queue natively to language-model agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in addition to a CLI and HTTP API. Designed for research workflows where compute outlives any single interactive session.
